original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independently audit PR #3647 (head 36ff4414)'s composed R437 bit supplier: the helper464 joint GL deletion composed with #1043's helper470 deletion, against single-change controls #589+E464 (the PR's R438) and #589+E470 (#1043's R438, rebuilt). Word level: the exact F2 identity on all 659 inputs with arbitrary dirty helpers, by a forward replay and a reverse pull-back, plus the literal reverse orientation; literal reconstruction of R437 from selected #589; aligned-trace non-interaction; SOURCE77 frame-186 chronology and all SOURCE write boundaries; the local profile and its deltas; exact rational projector identities as a second frame method. Stretch, completed: byte binding of the PR's records and the template's local programs; the parent schedule and idle windows from main's recipe and hosting rule; legality of the 3,933 slots per replica, and all 288 calls' owners and local-program hashes; the whole paid profile; the invoice precision envelope including the payload-prefix and ROW caps; and an independent exact price bracket for c, with positive controls reproducing selected #589's a and #1043's c. Plus 18 word mutants, 4 hosting mutants and 2 single-child price mutants, all rejected, and one positive control.
scope_change_reason: The card's default object is a complex-moment/assembly claim (#2979). The loop's picker drew the bit-mechanisms track, and PR #3647 makes the highest open bit-supplier value (c = 0.001736628253427115). Apart from the author's own checks, it had only arithmetic or author-code checks: PR3668 checks the histogram-to-c arithmetic, and the concurrent PR3690 (opened during this audit) reconstructs paid requests with predecessor and author code. The card's method, reconstructing a coordinated change against its single-change controls, is applied to that supplier. Correction: orientation originally justified the switch by claiming the bit side would bind if PR3653/PR3682 were admitted. That rested on a mixed-convention comparison (an 8.57e-9 gap between #589's retained cap a/(1+a) and #3653's modern-outer kappa) and is withdrawn. Under either consistent convention the bit side keeps about 3.0e-6 of headroom.
bottleneck_link: Under the selected chain's inherited semantics, PR #3647's bit supplier c = 0.001736628253427115 (retained cap 0.0017336176; modern-outer bit value 0.0017366283) now has an independent finite check from the literal word through hosting to the price root. There is no near-term kappa consequence. The complex primitive binds today, and it would still bind if PR3653/PR3682 were admitted: the bit headroom is 2.998e-6 under the retained transfer and 3.008e-6 under the modern outer. The bit supplier caps kappa only after a further complex gain of about 3.0e-6, and this check then applies to the highest open bit value. It also surfaces one new admission item: E464 changes the dirt pattern of the captured totals h477/h478.
stop_rule: Stop at the first of: a confirmed discrepancy (minimize with mutants); a full PASS of identity, composition, controls, chronology, profile and mutants with both methods agreeing; word semantics not pinned within about 60 min (hand off); or a PR head change (re-pin once). Outcome: full PASS of the core within the semantics budget. The bounded hosted-invoice stretch (at most 60 min) also completed inside the experiment window: hosting, profile, precision envelope and price bracket. c is reproduced under the inherited semantics, not admitted.

open_questions.question: Is the dirt-only change to two COPY sources contract-neutral? E464 changes the arbitrary-dirt content of retained totals h477/h478 by helper 340's column while their clean rows are unchanged.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The rank-7 captures rely on the inherited 'one paid transform plus linear private-stream discard' contract. If that contract depended on the dirt pattern of a captured total, the GL edit would need a separate native argument.
open_questions.first_step: State the native capture lemma's hypotheses as used by selected #589 and check them on the two affected captures.
open_questions.blocked_by: Locating the native capture lemma statement in the selected sources.

open_questions.question: Does the E464 pattern recur: which other carriers of #589/R437 have a clean contribution recoverable from the output roles of the single node that reads them?
open_questions.why_it_matters: E464 is the new mechanism in PR #3647. A census would show whether it is isolated or a family, which bears on whether further bit-supplier gains of this kind exist.
open_questions.first_step: Run a read-only census of carriers with one birth whose reads are confined to one node frame, and record the five-point expansion decision before any construction round.
open_questions.blocked_by: The expansion gate; no construction is authorized by this audit.
